tool.result.unavailable: the reference does not exist, has expired, was invalidated by a server restart, or the file was cleaned up or changed; call the original tool again
tool.result.ref_create_failed: failed to create the result reference
tool.result.ref_notice:
**result_ref**: `{{.Ref}}`

**read hint**: call cleanfetch(result_ref, offset=0) and continue with next_offset until eof=true. The reference is local to this service and becomes invalid after a server restart or file cleanup; it expires at {{.Expires}} at the latest.
tool.result.offset_invalid: offset must be non-negative and limit must be within 0-8192
tool.result.offset_beyond_end: offset is past the end of the result
tool.dump.overflow_notice: the rendered search results span {{.Results}} items / {{.Chars}} characters and exceed the inline limit ({{.Limit}} characters), so the whole set was saved to a file
tool.dump.create_exhausted: gave up creating the dump file after repeated retries
tool.init.search_not_initialized: the search engine is not initialized; check the configuration
tool.academic.disabled: the academic search engine is not enabled; check whether bing.academic is true
tool.academic.exact_no_result: exact academic lookup returned no results

tool.summarize.search_done.one: Search finished with 1 result, generating the summary...
tool.summarize.search_done.other: Search finished with {{.Count}} results, generating the summary...

tool.cache.config_serialize_failed: failed to serialize the search cache configuration
tool.history.empty: No history yet. Every successful smartsearch is recorded automatically (while search_history.enabled is on).
tool.history.hint: Hint: the above are local history snapshots with truncated bodies; use cleanfetch on a URL to re-fetch the full body.
tool.history.disabled: search_history is not enabled (search_history.enabled is off by default)
tool.security.private_host: access to private addresses is not allowed: {{.Host}}
tool.security.private_ip: access to private addresses is not allowed: {{.Host}} → {{.IP}}
tool.security.private_ip_connect: connecting to private addresses is not allowed: {{.Host}} → {{.IP}}
tool.security.download_dial_failed: cannot connect to the download address: {{.Host}}
tool.security.pdf_proxy_host_missing: the PDF proxy address has no hostname
tool.security.file_too_large: the file is too large ({{.Size}}MB) and exceeds the {{.Limit}}MB limit; raise cleanfetch.max_fetch_size_mb to fetch it
tool.security.pdf_over_download_limit: the PDF exceeds the {{.Limit}}MB download limit
tool.search.api_not_ready: the search API is not initialized
tool.search.time_range_invalid: time_range is out of the valid range
tool.search.no_valid_results: the search returned no valid results
tool.search.page_empty_maybe_antibot: the page content is empty (possibly blocked by anti-bot protection)
tool.search.antibot_blocked: > ⚠️ The site's anti-bot protection blocked the full-text fetch (JS challenge / WAF / CAPTCHA): the page body is unavailable, only the summary and URL above. Use another source, or retry the page later with cleanfetch.
tool.search.fetch_failed: > ⚠️ Full-text fetch failed ({{.Err}}): only the summary and URL above are available. Use cleanfetch to retry the page if you need the body.
tool.search.fetch_not_initialized: webfetch is not initialized; fetch_top_n needs cleanfetch or pdf_parser enabled
tool.search.body_saved: the body is long ({{.Lines}} lines, {{.Chars}} characters) and was saved to a file
tool.search.body_truncated: (the body exceeded the size limit and was truncated)
tool.cleanfetch.ref_url_conflict: result_ref cannot be combined with url/urls
tool.cleanfetch.offset_requires_ref: offset/limit are only used when reading a result_ref
tool.cleanfetch.url_fetch_disabled: cleanfetch URL fetching is turned off; you can still read a saved body through result_ref
tool.cleanfetch.url_required: provide at least one of url or urls
tool.cleanfetch.batch_too_large: a batch fetch takes at most {{.Max}} URLs (got {{.Count}}); split it into several calls
tool.cleanfetch.no_fetcher_initialized: neither webfetch nor jina reader is initialized
tool.cleanfetch.saved_to_file: the content was saved to a file ({{.Lines}} lines, {{.Chars}} characters)
tool.filesearch.disabled: file_search is not enabled (Everything HTTP Server is unavailable)
tool.filesearch.sort_unsupported: sort supports only name / path / size / date_modified, got "{{.Value}}"
tool.filesearch.time_format_unsupported: time_format supports only datetime / iso / filetime, got "{{.Value}}"
tool.filesearch.no_match: no files match `{{.Query}}`. Broaden the keywords, check the directory scope, or use syntax such as ext:/dm:.
tool.filesearch.page_capped_empty: {{.Total}} hits, but page {{.Page}} is empty: the candidate pool reached its cap of {{.Cap}}, so deeper pages yield no new candidates. Narrow the query and search again.
tool.filesearch.page_last_empty: {{.Total}} hits, but page {{.Page}} is empty (past the last page). Go back to page 1 or narrow the query.
tool.filesearch.summary: {{.Total}} hits; page {{.Page}} returns {{.Count}} (up to {{.PageSize}} per page, {{.Order}}):
tool.filesearch.max_results_clamped: max_results exceeded the hard cap of {{.Cap}} and was clamped to {{.PageSize}}; use page to paginate for more results.
tool.filesearch.page_clamped: page exceeded the limit of {{.Max}} and was clamped to page {{.Page}}.
tool.filesearch.more_pages: more results are available; continue with page={{.Next}} (or narrow the query to reduce paging).
tool.filesearch.pool_capped: the candidate pool reached its cap of {{.Cap}} and cannot go deeper. Narrow the query (ext:/dm:/size: or add a subdirectory) and search again.
tool.filesearch.filtered: {{.Total}} hits, {{.Count}} kept after filtering (weak matches and noisy directories removed). Narrow the query or lower min_alignment.
tool.pdf.wait_seconds_invalid: wait_seconds must be between 0 and 1800 seconds
tool.pdf.taskref_page_hint: a task_ref query reuses the original task's pages; omit path and pages
tool.pdf.webfetch_not_initialized: webfetch is not initialized; enable cleanfetch first
tool.pdf.pages_over_limit: pages selects {{.Count}} pages, over the per-call limit max_pages={{.Max}}; split it into several calls (e.g. pages="1-{{.Max}}")
tool.pdf.mineru_imprecise_preamble: > MinerU did not return a precise result ({{.Err}}); this response is PDF text extraction and images are not included.
tool.pdf.local_path_hint: ; the local path must be visible to the service process — in Docker use a container path or a mounted path, not a host path from file_search
tool.pdf.mineru_downloading_for_crop: MinerU cannot parse the original file directly; downloading it to crop locally...
tool.pdf.crop_prepare_failed: preparing the local crop of the remote PDF failed
tool.pdf.crop_failed: cropping the remote PDF locally failed
tool.pdf.crop_no_pages: cropping the remote PDF locally failed: no parseable page within the {{.Budget}}-page budget
tool.pdf.batch_start: starting batch {{.Index}}/{{.Total}}: cropping original pages {{.From}}-{{.To}} and uploading to MinerU...
tool.pdf.batch_pending:
> precise text for the first {{.DoneBatches}} batches ({{.DonePages}} pages) is available; batch {{.Index}}/{{.Total}}, original pages {{.From}}-{{.To}}, is not finished. A follow-up reference returns only that batch, with page numbers restarting at 1.
> {{.Message}}

tool.pdf.batch_done: batch {{.Index}}/{{.Total}} done (original pages {{.From}}-{{.To}}); {{.Parsed}}/{{.Selected}} pages parsed so far
tool.pdf.merged_section: ### original pages {{.From}}-{{.To}} (batch {{.Index}}/{{.Total}}, page numbers restart at 1)
tool.pdf.preamble_cropped: > the original PDF has {{.Total}} pages; the {{.Parsed}} needed pages were cropped locally and uploaded to MinerU; result page numbers restart at 1.
tool.pdf.preamble_batched: > the original PDF has {{.Total}} pages; it was cropped locally and uploaded to MinerU in {{.Batches}} batches (at most {{.BatchSize}} pages each, submitted serially). Page numbers restart at 1 per batch and the original page numbers appear in each section heading. This call parsed original pages {{.From}}-{{.To}} ({{.Pages}} pages).
tool.pdf.page_budget_used: > the {{.Budget}}-page budget for one call is used up; call again and select the remaining pages with pages (e.g. "{{.From}}-{{.To}}").
